records.source: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
records.validation_method: Official KMZ downloaded and parsed; official page identifies an out-and-back route whose rutometer reaches the Aznaitin summit at km 4.8 and returns by the same path. The KMZ is the outbound unique geometry (4.750 km) and must be rendered with return_same_path=true rather than duplicating coordinates.
records.notes: The official route page explicitly says ida y vuelta and the ascent ends at km 4.8; the downloaded geometry matches that outbound leg.
